seq_cycle.note: seq_cycle r c: c is a cycle of r (consecutive entries and the closing pair related, MathComp cycle) with pairwise distinct entries (uniq) and at least three entries; no symmetry or irreflexivity premise on r; empty, one-entry and digon sequences excluded, invariant under rotation, and under reversal given the hypothesis symmetric r (sufficient).

seq_cycleb.note: seq_cycleb r c: the Boolean form ucycleb r c && (2 < size c), reflected to seq_cycle by seq_cycleP.
